notes: New: Posts. Paste the RSS link from any course's Announcements in the Learning Hub once, and Sybl keeps your instructors' announcements for every class, checking for new ones each time it syncs. Each class has its own page with its posts in full, older months tucked away, a search, and every link the class has shared in one list. Links to your course site now say "Open in the Learning Hub". Sybl is also more careful with very large calendar downloads. Plus small fixes.
